baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated clauses place covers over hearts against understanding and heaviness in ears against reception.
baseline_models.mechanism: A causatively produced condition encloses the inward seat of understanding and loads the channel of attentive hearing, creating cognitive and auditory gates that converge on failed reception.

activation_trace.role: Supplies causative rendering and makes the blockage an imposed condition rather than a bare description.
Locates the first gate in the heart as the seat of inward understanding and responsiveness.
Contributes an enclosing cover that functions here as a guarded inner boundary around reception.
Defines the blocked outcome as grasping meaning, not merely encountering words.
Extends the ear from an organ to attentive acceptance and thus identifies a second reception gate.
Loads the auditory gate with heaviness that obstructs effective hearing.

changed_reading.before: The audience simply cannot understand or hear the recitation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages coordinated inward and auditory gates: meaning is enclosed at the heart while attentive acceptance is burdened at the ear.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence begins when the Lord is mentioned alone in the Quran and ends with turning, exposed backs, and flight.
baseline_models.mechanism: A verbal mention within recitation concentrates lordship without partner; that exclusivity triggers a linked bodily sequence of disengagement, back-turning, and increasing distance.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the voiced mention that initiates the conditional response.
Contributes sovereign lordship as the object whose exclusive naming matters.
Locates the triggering mention within recited discourse.
Sharpens the trigger as divine oneness without a partner, not mention in general.
Begins the response as active withdrawal and refusal of proximity.
Makes withdrawal visible as presenting the back and refusing engagement.
Completes the sequence as recoil and widening distance from the trigger.

changed_reading.before: They generally dislike hearing the Quran.
changed_reading.after: Their retreat is specifically keyed to recited lordship made exclusive, and the ayah renders that rejection as an ordered movement away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeats an input-response pattern: varied Quranic presentation increases flight, and later displayed material plus warning functions as a test whose reception increases transgression. The focus retreat is therefore one turn in a recurrent amplification loop.

activation_trace.role: Provides the recited input whose exclusive content elicits the focus response.
Provides the focus output as recoil and increased distance.
Supplies repeated variation from one presentation to another as the loop's changing input.
Marks the response as growth rather than a stable quantity.
Frames disclosed material as an assay that reveals the receiver's condition.
Repeats the growth operator and links warning to an intensified response.
Names the amplified output as boundary-crossing disobedience.

structural_cues: 17:41 and 17:60 both use an exclusive increase construction after revelatory input, while 17:41 also repeats Quran, remembrance, and flight from the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies variation, testing, warning, and repeated increase; I supply the feedback arrow that each reception event intensifies the next recoil. A live alternative is that revelation only exposes an already increasing refusal rather than producing it.

changed_reading.before: The turning away in 17:46 is a single reaction to one exclusive mention.
changed_reading.after: The reaction belongs to a recursive reception pattern in which renewed disclosure diagnoses and amplifies the audience's established direction of travel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hypothetical co-deities seek a route toward the throne, and the beings people call upon are themselves seekers. Mentioning the Lord alone therefore removes an imagined chain of terminal patrons and reclassifies every intermediary as dependent.

activation_trace.role: Provides the sovereign center to which all claimed powers are subordinated.
Makes the sovereign center exclusive and disallows a partner at the endpoint.
Supplies the proposed objects of worship whose terminal status is being tested.
Turns the proposed co-deities into seekers rather than final possessors.
Provides the traversable route that places the alleged powers below a destination.
Identifies the invoked figures as recipients of human calling rather than independent endpoints.
Repeats seeking on the invoked figures' side and exposes their dependence.

structural_cues: 17:42 places alleged gods on a path toward the throne; 17:56-57 deny the invoked figures control over harm and depict them seeking access to their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested seekers and one sovereign destination; I infer that 'alone' collapses a mediation network, which explains the intensity of the retreat. A live alternative is a narrower rejection of numerical plurality without a social-patronage mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The audience recoils from an abstract assertion that God is one.
changed_reading.after: The exclusive mention strips every invoked patron of endpoint status, so the recoil protects a whole hierarchy of imagined access and dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, universal praise is present but not understood. The heart-covering thus blocks recognition of a discourse already saturating creation, making the defect selective interpretation rather than absence of signal.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the focus defect in understanding and permits comparison with the adjacent failure to understand praise.
Supplies pervasive declaration of divine transcendence as meaningful discourse surrounding the hearers.
Gives that pervasive discourse an evaluative content of praise rather than undifferentiated sound.

structural_cues: 17:44 states that every thing praises while the addressees do not understand that praise, using the same understanding root that anchors 17:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal praise and adjacent failures of understanding; I infer one selective hermeneutic incapacity spanning creation and recitation. A live alternative is that 17:44 and 17:46 address related but distinct failures.

changed_reading.before: The covers prevent decoding one recited message.
changed_reading.after: The covers exemplify a broader inability to recognize the praise-bearing order in which the recitation participates, despite abundant signal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding hidden screen between reciter and nonbelievers becomes the outer layer of the focus's internal covers and auditory load. Separation is distributed across relation, cognition, and hearing rather than confined inside an individual.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the inner enclosing layer around the heart's reception.
Adds a second internal layer by burdening the auditory channel.
Supplies an outer barrier that prevents access between speaker and audience.
Makes the outer barrier itself concealed, explaining why physical proximity can coexist with failed contact.

structural_cues: 17:45 places an unseen barrier between reciter and nonbelievers; 17:46 immediately relocates parallel obstructions onto hearts and into ears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent external and internal barriers; I arrange them as concentric layers from relation to cognition to hearing. A live alternative is that the clauses are parallel metaphors without a single layered architecture.

changed_reading.before: The problem is an internal defect located only in the hearers.
changed_reading.after: The pericope constructs a hidden barrier system across the interpersonal space, the heart, and the ear, allowing visible listening without genuine contact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah confirms acoustic listening, then moves through private conference to a charge of enchantment. Auditory material enters, but a social interpretive circuit diverts it before acceptance and understanding.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the blocked auditory function in attentive acceptance rather than sound detection alone.
Marks the heard material as unable to pass normally through the auditory gate.
Confirms repeated perception of sound and rules out simple acoustic absence.
Moves the received material into a private social exchange where its meaning is renegotiated.
Supplies the final recoding as deceptive diversion rather than recognized revelation.

structural_cues: 17:47 repeats active listening twice before reporting private speech and the label applied to the reciter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acoustic hearing, private conference, and a deceptive classification; I supply the directional chain from hearing through group recoding to rejected acceptance. A live alternative is that the private speech merely reports a settled judgment formed earlier.

changed_reading.before: The weight in their ears means that the Quran does not reach them as sound.
changed_reading.after: They hear it, but attentive acceptance is burdened by a social recoding process that converts revelation into a dismissive explanation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present mention meets auditory burden and flight, but a later divine call receives immediate answer with praise. The gate is therefore temporally situated, not an absolute incapacity of the human hearing-response system.

activation_trace.role: Provides the presently blocked movement from hearing to acceptance.
Supplies the present response as active distancing from the call's content.
Introduces a later summons that again addresses the hearing-response channel.
Reverses present recoil by supplying an actual answer to the later summons.
Qualifies the future answer with praise, opposing the present dismissive reception.

structural_cues: 17:52 shifts from the focus's present mention-and-flight sequence to a future call-and-response sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed response sequences at different times; I infer a temporal reversal of the same reception capacity. A live alternative is that the later compelled response does not modify the moral closure described in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The covers and auditory weight describe a fixed inability to respond.
changed_reading.after: They describe a present mode of resistant reception that will be overturned when a later call elicits answer and praise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a turning sense from the root of the noun 'hearts'; it remains anchored because the same ayah explicitly chains turning, backs, and flight. Render it only as an intraversal root echo, not as a replacement meaning for hearts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heart term and the closing sequence of turning onto backs can be read as an inside-out reversal pattern.

activation_trace.role: Activates reversal latent in the heart root and lets inward orientation echo the later bodily turn.
Supplies the explicit outward pivot away from engagement.
Makes that pivot concrete as presentation of the back.
Extends the pivot into recoil and widening distance.

changed_reading.before: Internal covering and outward flight are two separate symptoms.
changed_reading.after: The ayah may echo one reversal across scales: inward orientation fails, then the body externalizes that failure by turning its back and fleeing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from k-n-n to k-w-n; it remains formally packet-anchored and is activated by repeated contextual being-language. Render it as a secondary resonance about produced state or subjection, never as the lexical sense of the covers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative making of the covers can weakly resonate with the packet's split mapping toward a made condition of being or submission.

activation_trace.role: Supplies transition into a produced condition and keeps the resonance tied to the focus syntax.
The split target contributes a distant image of subjection, recasting the obstruction as a condition imposed on agency.
Contextual being-language activates the shared mapped target and stresses the occurrence of states in time.

changed_reading.before: The covers are only fixed objects laid over the hearts.
changed_reading.after: At a contained secondary level, the covers may also register as a produced state of subdued agency, a condition that occurs rather than an immutable substance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it overlays the focus's vivid escape motion with later encompassing space; it remains anchored in the exact flight sequence and the contextual enclosure. Render it without denying that their withdrawal is real at the interpersonal and moral levels.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: They turn their backs and flee, yet the later context says their Lord encompasses the people.

activation_trace.role: Supplies deliberate withdrawal from the recited encounter.
Gives withdrawal a directed body geometry with the back facing the encounter.
Carries the geometry into active distancing.
Places the distancing motion inside a larger enclosure it cannot spatially outrun.

changed_reading.before: Turning away creates successful distance from the exclusive mention of the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The flight creates real discursive distance while remaining bounded by the very lordship from which the hearers recoil.

strongest_changes: The repeated increase constructions in 17:41 and 17:60 turn the focus reaction into a recursive diagnostic-amplification loop.
The hidden screen of 17:45 and the confirmed listening of 17:47 relocate the problem from acoustic absence to layered access and socially mediated acceptance.
The seeking intermediaries of 17:42 and 17:57 make 'your Lord alone' a collapse of an entire mediation hierarchy.
The call-and-answer sequence of 17:52 prevents the present blockage from being read as an absolute human incapacity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses causative inner enclosure, burdened acceptance, exclusive lordship, and coordinated bodily retreat; its context then exposes both the social circuitry and the temporal reversibility of that reception failure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the divine making names a direct causal imposition, the ratification of prior refusal, or both remains unresolved.
The linkage between universal praise in 17:44 and the specific hearers in 17:46 may be analogical rather than one continuous incapacity.
The k-n-n to k-w-n activation is explicitly exploratory and may reflect only a form-distant mapped resonance.
